name: kaola-workflow
description: Kaola-Workflow for Codex, a public repo-backed workflow pack driven by an adaptive, resumable mission list, automated Codex agent profiles, roadmap mirroring, TDD execution, review, and finalization gates.

interface.longDescription: Kaola-Workflow for Codex exposes repo-backed skills and Codex-native agent profiles for project initialization, workflow-init, and adaptive, resumable execution: the orchestrator writes a mission list of items, reads the frontier, dispatches subagents when useful, and closes items as their results land, through research, planning, TDD execution, review, documentation docking, and finalization.
